Voter workshop

Jan911 amDEMO event

DEMO event Learn Alcohol-free

Spanish-language voter workshop: what changed for 2027

  • Sat, Jan 9 · 11 am to 12:30 pm
  • Casselberry · Free

Are you in?

I'm in
NKM+1922 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

In Spanish, in plain words, with time for every question.

What's the plan

An hour and a half, in Spanish, to catch up on what's new: renewing your mail-ballot request (requests made before Nov 3, 2026 ended Dec 31), which ID to bring now that Florida no longer takes student IDs at the polls, and what the new citizenship check means when you register or update your record. We use the official Spanish-language pages wherever they exist. No question is too basic, and families are welcome.

Starting Jan 1, 2027, Florida stops accepting student IDs at the polls (it's being challenged in court). Bring a driver's license, state ID or passport, and check voteseminole.gov before you go.

Getting in

Large-print handouts. Room for strollers and wheelchairs (we'll confirm the venue). Coffee and something sweet.

What to bring

  • Your questions
  • Your phone, to look up your own voter record
  • Reading glasses, if you use them
  • Family, if they want to come

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • HB 991 (Ch. 2026-26), signed Apr 1, 2026, removes student IDs from Florida's list of accepted photo IDs at the polls starting Jan 1, 2027.

    Source: flsenate.gov · Source: flsenate.gov

  • A federal lawsuit filed Oct 16, 2026 challenges the student-ID ban.

    Source: democracydocket.com

  • Starting Jan 1, 2027, HB 991 requires a check of DHSMV (driver license office) REAL ID data related to citizenship for new registrations and for voters updating their registration.

    Source: flsenate.gov

  • Florida vote-by-mail requests made before the Nov 3, 2026 general election ended Dec 31, 2026.

    Source: flsenate.gov

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
